items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: And this boy, they call him Hood. He plays banjo and piano.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. With George Williams. Yeah, that's right. That's his name. I can't think of his name.

I'm telling the truth, all of them call him Brown so much, they never can think of it. Yeah, I can't think of it now. And this boy, they call him Hood. He plays banjo and piano. He's tall, tall. And this is a new card right back here. We call him Trumpet there. Yeah, yeah.
